messages:
nina.prod: Quick sync: propose we pivot GA roadmap to a tiered burst-credit model with decay windows instead of full carryover. this reduces long-tail capacity spikes and simplifies billing. thoughts?
oscar.eng: I like tiered credits. concrete idea: small pools get a fixed +1 GPU headroom, larger pools get % headroom. decay windows: unused burst credits expire over 72h, but pilot customers can opt-in to paid carryover.
liya.infra: Infra concerns: decay windows make forecasting easier, but we need a spillback policy when headroom is low: prefer queue-with-timeout -> regional spill -> preempt. also recommend a soft preemption delay (60s) to avoid flapping.
harry.se: SE ask: surface two counters in UI: "live_burst_balance" and "decay_schedule". also expose API to query projected refill and expiry timestamps.
olga.sales: Sales: pilots want carryover for revenue certainty. we'll offer carryover as paid addon; default decay=72h for GA. need sample pricing for small/medium/large pools.
cost-bot: Estimate stub: with 15% headroom default and 72h decay, expected overage for average pilot is ~X% (requires real usage inputs).
nina.prod: Draft GA acceptance bullets: 1) tiered headroom defaults (fixed floor for pools <4 gpus, pct for larger pools), 2) decay window implemented (72h) + carryover opt-in flag, 3) spillback policy documented (queue -> regional -> preempt) with 60s preempt delay, 4) autoscale defaults: cooldown 300s, hysteresis 15%, proportional prewarm formula, 5) telemetry: dedicated.burst.balance, dedicated.burst.decay_events, dedicated.spillback.count, 6) billing SKUs: reserved_commit, burst_metered, carryover_addon.
oscar.eng: I'll prototype the proportional prewarm rule and run a quick sim (ceil(pool_gpus*0.18), clamp [1,12]). due Tue EOD.
liya.infra: I'll run capacity sims for us-west/eu-west with decay windows and spillback logic included. due Wed noon.
harry.se: I'll make simple UI mocks for live_burst_balance + decay timeline. due Wed EOD.
olga.sales: I'll gather 3 pilot pricing constraints and preferences. due Thu.
nina.prod: If simulations look good we'll ship GA with decay-based default and carryover as paid opt-in. If sims show unacceptable tail risk, we revert to a smaller decay window and re-evaluate. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
__notes: single slack thread; messages concatenated; follows agents.md rules
